direction: Simple ivory clay navigation pictograms and a sparse transparent grapevine corner for the profile header.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE tiny navigation icon for a Russian botanical clay mini-app, to be displayed at 28–32 pixels.
The supplied reference is ONLY for its warm IVORY modelling-clay material and soft hand-sculpted cream lettering. Do NOT copy the banner, words, oak branch or leaves.
Make a SINGLE minimal solid pictogram, centered on a genuinely transparent background, filling about 82% of a square canvas with even margins. Straight-on frontal view, zero isometric tilt or perspective, softly rounded thick shapes, gentle shallow 3D depth, subtle beige side shading and a very small soft shadow directly under the object. Matte warm cream/ivory plasticine (#F5E6D3), extremely restrained fine grain, clean silhouette that remains legible at 28px. Monochrome ivory, only warm beige shading; no colored accents, no realistic details.
All shapes should be BOLD and SIMPLE, not thin line-art or an ornate illustration. Consistent scale and visual weight for the four-icon set. No enclosing app tile, circle background, badge, border, text, letters, numbers, decorative foliage, tabletop, extra props or watermark. Background must be actual transparent alpha, not white or checkerboard.
Subject: a small closed notebook with softly rounded corners, one simple spine seam, and ONE short thick diagonal pencil resting across its lower-right corner. Just the notebook and pencil; two big readable shapes. No spiral rings, visible words, ruling or tiny marks.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a decorative corner overlay for a profile-card header, genuinely transparent background. The supplied reference is ONLY for the project's restrained botanical plasticine material, warm light and muted palette. Create ONE airy slender GRAPEVINE CORNER, arranged like a loose inverted L: a thin warm beige/taupe vine follows the upper edge then gently bends DOWN along the RIGHT edge. Two or three soft curved tendrils, just THREE small separated grape leaves: one warm ivory and two pale desaturated gray-sage. Very little green; no bright green. The thin vine and leaves occupy only the top and right perimeter of the square, leaving at least 75% of the center and lower-left completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT so UI text and an avatar can remain legible. Matte gently sculpted clay with restrained pressed veins, low relief, soft warm light, minimal details. No grapes, fruit, flowers, portrait, text, UI card, rectangle outline, opaque background, soil, pedestal or watermark. The entire isolated corner plant must be contained within the square with clear margins and real transparent alpha, not white or checkerboard.
